title: proof
description: A proof held by the profile, at the path `proof/<id>`, of one of two kinds, told apart by which of `credential` and `membership` it carries. A credential: one copy of a W3C verifiable credential issued to the profile. A membership: a proof that the human behind one of the profile's registry lines is also on another issuer's list, for the same label and profile (registry/README.md).

issuer.description: The issuer's DID. For a membership, its did:key: the key its published roots are signed with.

credential.description: The verifiable credential as issued, unchanged: its JSON text, or its compact form (a JWT). Text, because a credential's own keys, such as @context, are not keys an entry allows.

membership.description: A Semaphore proof against the issuer's list, made for one of the profile's registry lines: the line's label and code, the list's root, and the proof. A reader checks it against the line with this code and the roots the issuer published.

code.description: The line's code, the proof's nullifier: 32 bytes as lowercase hex.

root.description: The root of the issuer's list the proof was made against: 32 bytes as lowercase hex.

proof.description: The proof's eight coordinates in Semaphore's packed order, each 32 bytes big-endian as lowercase hex.
